summary: The bank mostly sounds like DUMMIES. The Luxury lines are polished and indignant, and the Corporate lines log and file. Several lines state things the simulation never logged: an invented rating, an invented one-minute delay, a 'quiet stretch', a district-wide remark, and 'now late' or 'now delayed' claims.

issues.found: That fell from high up. Harder than rated.
issues.rule: A line may only say what the game state guarantees. No rating is logged, so 'harder than rated' is an unlogged claim.
issues.fix: That fell from high up. Noted in my log.

issues.found: High drop logged. Load exceeds rating 3.
issues.rule: Barks react to logged events only. No load or rating is logged, and 'rating 3' has no registry ID.
issues.fix: High drop logged. Incident form 3 filed.

issues.found: A roof drop. My schedule slips by a minute.
issues.rule: A line may only say what state guarantees. A one-minute delay is an invented figure that nothing logged.
issues.fix: A roof drop. My schedule will suffer.

issues.found: Riverside run logged. Quiet stretch, then this.
issues.rule: A line may only say what state guarantees. 'Quiet stretch' is not logged, and traffic in Riverside is not guaranteed to have been quiet.

issues.found: Old Market congestion. Dwell time rising.
issues.rule: Barks react to logged events only. Congestion and a rising dwell time are not logged at the moment of impact.
issues.fix: Old Market route. Dwell time logged.

issues.found: Interchange timing is tight. Now delayed.
issues.rule: An impact does not guarantee a delay. The 'stopped' field is not tested, so 'now delayed' is an unlogged claim.
issues.fix: Interchange timing is tight. Impact logged.

issues.found: CBD arrivals are timed. I am now late.
issues.rule: An impact does not guarantee lateness. The 'stopped' field is not tested, so 'now late' is an unlogged claim.
issues.fix: CBD arrivals are timed. This will be noted.

issues.found: FARSIGHT Campus. Everything here is logged.
issues.rule: Every line must speak of the car's own job, schedule, route, passengers, paintwork or log. A general remark about the place is out.
issues.fix: FARSIGHT Campus. This hit is in my log.
